Population.evidence_source: The purpose of this study is to develop a deeper understanding of the experiences of persons who were in contact with psychiatric healthcare as a result of a suicide attempt.

Type.evidence_source: The purpose of this study is to develop a deeper understanding of the experiences of persons who were in contact with psychiatric healthcare as a result of a suicide attempt. The research question was 'What resources in the person himself or herself and his or her surroundings are crucial in a suicidal crisis to maintaining the will to live and hope for life'?

Area.evidence_source: An unbearable psychological pain is well documented as suicide's most important stressor2 and perceived hopelessness as a central emotion and risk factor in suicidality. The research question was 'What resources in the person himself or herself and his or her surroundings are crucial in a suicidal crisis to maintaining the will to live and hope for life'?
